name: Dizzy Punch
shortDescription: 20% chance to confuse the target.

description: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.
longDescription: The user and its ally's Abilities change to match the target's Ability. Does not change Ability if the user's or its ally's is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target. Fails if both the user and its ally's Ability already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
name: Doodle
shortDescription: User and ally's Abilities become target's Ability.

description: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.
longDescription: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Future Sight is already in effect for the target's position.
name: Doom Desire
shortDescription: Hits two turns after being used.

description: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Double Hit
shortDescription: Hits 2 times in one turn.

description: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Double Iron Bash
shortDescription: Hits twice. 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Double Kick
shortDescription: Hits 2 times in one turn.

description: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.
longDescription: Fails unless the user is an Electric type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Electric type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.
name: Double Shock
shortDescription: User's Electric type: typeless; must be Electric.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.
name: Double Slap
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.
longDescription: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.
name: Double Team
shortDescription: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1.

description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.
longDescription: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Double-Edge
shortDescription: Has 33% recoil.

description: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
name: Draco Meteor
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

description: The user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Dragon Ascent
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Dragon Breath
shortDescription: 30% chance to paralyze the target.

description: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
longDescription: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.
name: Dragon Cheer
shortDescription: Ally: Crit ratio +1, or +2 if ally is Dragon type.

description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.
name: Dragon Claw
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.
name: Dragon Dance
shortDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1.

description: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.
name: Dragon Darts
shortDescription: Hits twice. Doubles: Tries to hit each foe once.

description: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
longDescription: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
name: Dragon Energy
shortDescription: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

description: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
name: Dragon Hammer
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
name: Dragon Pulse
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
name: Dragon Rage
shortDescription: Deals 40 HP of damage to the target.

description: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
name: Dragon Rush
shortDescription: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
longDescription: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
name: Dragon Tail
shortDescription: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Drain Punch
shortDescription: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

description: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Draining Kiss
shortDescription: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.

description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The target is unaffected by this move unless it is asleep. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Dream Eater
shortDescription: User gains 1/2 HP inflicted. Sleeping target only.

description: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.
name: Drill Peck
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Drill Run
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio.

description: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Drum Beating
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Dual Chop
shortDescription: Hits 2 times in one turn.

description: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Dual Wingbeat
shortDescription: Hits 2 times in one turn.

description: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.
name: Dynamax Cannon
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.
name: Dynamic Punch
shortDescription: 100% chance to confuse the target.

description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Earth Power
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
longDescription: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.
name: Earthquake
shortDescription: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dig.

description: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.
longDescription: For every consecutive turn that this move is used by at least one Pokemon, this move's power is multiplied by the number of turns to pass, but not more than 5.
name: Echoed Voice
shortDescription: Power increases when used on consecutive turns.

description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.
name: Eerie Impulse
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 2.

description: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
longDescription: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the target loses 3 PP from its last move.
name: Eerie Spell
shortDescription: Removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
name: Egg Bomb
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.
name: Electric Terrain
shortDescription: 5 turns. Grounded: +Electric power, can't sleep.

description: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target’s move becomes Electric type.
longDescription: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
name: Electrify
shortDescription: Changes the target's move to Electric this turn.

description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.
name: Electro Ball
shortDescription: More power the faster the user is than the target.

description: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.
longDescription: Damage is multiplied by 1.3333 if this move is super effective against the target.
name: Electro Drift
shortDescription: Deals 1.3333× damage with supereffective hits.

description: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
longDescription: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move still requires a turn to charge.
name: Electro Shot
shortDescription: Raises Sp. Atk by 1, hits turn 2. Rain: no charge.

description: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Electroweb
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the target's held item has no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by the target. Items thrown at the target with Fling will still activate for it. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to use items.
name: Embargo
shortDescription: For 5 turns, the target's item has no effect.

description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
name: Ember
shortDescription: 10% chance to burn the target.

description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
longDescription: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.
name: Encore
shortDescription: Target repeats its last move for its next 3 turns.

description: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.
name: Endeavor
shortDescription: Lowers the target's HP to the user's HP.

description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.
longDescription: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
name: Endure
shortDescription: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.

description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Energy Ball
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.
longDescription: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
name: Entrainment
shortDescription: The target's Ability changes to match the user's.

description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
longDescription: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
name: Eruption
shortDescription: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

description: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage and a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Esper Wing
shortDescription: 100% chance to raise user Speed by 1. High crit.

description: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
name: Eternabeam
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.
longDescription: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.
name: Expanding Force
shortDescription: User on Psychic Terrain: 1.5× power, hits foes.

description: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
longDescription: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
name: Explosion
shortDescription: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.

description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Extrasensory
shortDescription: 10% chance to make the target flinch.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 2 stages.
name: Extreme Evoboost
shortDescription: Raises user's Atk, Def, SpA, SpD, and Spe by 2.

description: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Extreme Speed
shortDescription: Nearly always goes first.

description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
longDescription: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.
name: Facade
shortDescription: Power doubles if user is burn/poison/paralyzed.

description: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
longDescription: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.
name: Fairy Lock
shortDescription: Prevents all Pokemon from switching next turn.

description: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.
name: Fairy Wind
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
name: Fake Out
shortDescription: Hits first. First turn out only. 100% flinch chance.

description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
name: Fake Tears
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.

description: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.
name: False Surrender
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy.

description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
longDescription: Leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
name: False Swipe
shortDescription: Always leaves the target with at least 1 HP.

description: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.
name: Feather Dance
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 2.

description: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.
longDescription: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.
name: Feint
shortDescription: Nullifies Detect, Protect, and Quick/Wide Guard.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
name: Feint Attack
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy.

description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat is boosted drastically.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack by 3 stages if this move knocks out the target.
name: Fell Stinger
shortDescription: Raises user's Attack by 3 if this KOes the target.

description: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.
name: Fickle Beam
shortDescription: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.

description: Cloaked in flames, the user attacks the target by dancing and flapping its wings. This may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Fiery Dance
shortDescription: 50% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

description: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Fiery Wrath
shortDescription: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

description: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed stat stages would not change.
name: Fillet Away
shortDescription: +2 Attack, Sp. Atk, Speed for 1/2 user's max HP.

description: The user risks everything to attack the target. The user faints but inflicts damage equal to its own HP.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.
name: Final Gambit
shortDescription: Does damage equal to the user's HP. User faints.

description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
name: Fire Blast
shortDescription: 10% chance to burn the target.

description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
name: Fire Fang
shortDescription: 10% chance to burn. 10% chance to flinch.

description: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Fire Lash
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

description: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast sea of fire appears.
longDescription: If one of the user's allies chose to use Grass Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Fire Gem.
name: Fire Pledge
shortDescription: Use with Grass or Water Pledge for added effect.

description: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
name: Fire Punch
shortDescription: 10% chance to burn the target.

description: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
name: Fire Spin
shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

description: Although this move has great power, it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
longDescription: Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
name: First Impression
shortDescription: Nearly always goes first. First turn out only.

description: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
longDescription: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.
name: Fishious Rend
shortDescription: Power doubles if user moves before the target.

description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
name: Fissure
shortDescription: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
name: Flail
shortDescription: More power the less HP the user has left.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the target's ally loses 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, unless it has the Magic Guard Ability.
name: Flame Burst
shortDescription: Damages Pokemon next to the target as well.

description: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Flame Charge

Camouflage transforms the user into a Grass type, Nature Power becomes Energy Ball, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause sleep. Fails if the current terrain is Grassy Terrain.
name: Grassy Terrain
shortDescription: 5 turns. Grounded: +Grass power, +1/16 max HP.

description: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. Power is multiplied by 1.5 during Gravity's effect.
name: Grav Apple
shortDescription: Target: 100% -1 Def. During Gravity: 1.5× power.

description: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.
name: Gravity
shortDescription: 5 turns: no Ground immunities, 1.67× accuracy.

description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Growl
shortDescription: Lowers the foe(s) Attack by 1.

description: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sun or Intense Sun, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sun or Intense Sun.
name: Growth
shortDescription: Raises user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; 2 in Sun.

description: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.
longDescription: Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that move loses all its remaining PP.
name: Grudge
shortDescription: If the user faints, the attack used loses all its PP.

description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.
longDescription: The user and the target have their Defense and Special Defense stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
name: Guard Split
shortDescription: Averages Defense and Sp. Def stats with target.

description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
longDescription: The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.
name: Guard Swap
shortDescription: Swaps Defense and Sp. Def changes with target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to 3/4 of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Guardian of Alola
shortDescription: Does damage equal to 3/4 target's current HP.

description: A vicious tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
name: Guillotine
shortDescription: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
name: Gunk Shot
shortDescription: 30% chance to poison the target.

description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
longDescription: Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.
name: Gust
shortDescription: Power doubles during Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop.

description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: Power is equal to (25 * target's current Speed / user's current Speed) + 1, rounded down, but not more than 150. If the user's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 1.
name: Gyro Ball
shortDescription: More power the slower the user than the target.

description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type or have the Ice Body, Magic Guard, Overcoat, or Snow Cloak Abilities. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Hail.
name: Hail
shortDescription: For 5 turns, hail crashes down.

description: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Hammer Arm
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Speed by 1.

description: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
name: Happy Hour
shortDescription: No competitive use.

description: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: Power is equal to 100 × (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
name: Hard Press
shortDescription: More power the more HP the target has left.

description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

description: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. This also damages the user a little.

name: Head Charge
shortDescription: Has 1/4 recoil.

description: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.
longDescription: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Head Smash
shortDescription: Has 1/2 recoil.

longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Headlong Rush
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.
longDescription: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.
name: Heal Bell
shortDescription: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

shortDescription: For 5 turns, the foe(s) is prevented from healing.

shortDescription: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.

This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets either of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. shortDescription: User faints. Next hurt Pokemon is fully healed.

shortDescription: More power the heavier the user than the target.

shortDescription: One adjacent ally's move power is 1.5× this turn.

description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.
longDescription: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

name: Horn Drill
shortDescription: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

name: Horn Leech
shortDescription: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

description: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.
longDescription: Raises the Attack of the user and all allies 1 stage.

shortDescription: Raises the user's and ally's Attack by 1.

If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
name: Hurricane
shortDescription: 30% chance to confuse target. Can't miss in rain.

name: Hydro Cannon
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
name: Hydro Pump
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.
longDescription: If the current weather is Sun and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella, this move's damage is multiplied by 1.5 instead of halved for being Water type.
name: Hydro Steam
shortDescription: During Sun: 1.5× damage instead of half.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
name: Hydro Vortex
shortDescription: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
name: Hyper Beam
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
name: Hyper Drill
shortDescription: Bypasses protection without breaking it.

description: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Hyper Fang
shortDescription: 10% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Hyper Voice
shortDescription: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

description: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. This also lowers the user's Defense stat.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Hoopa Unbound. If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.
name: Hyperspace Fury
shortDescription: Hoopa-U: Lowers user's Def by 1; breaks protect.

description: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
longDescription: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.
name: Hyperspace Hole
shortDescription: Breaks the target's protection for this turn.

description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.
name: Hypnosis
shortDescription: Causes the target to fall asleep.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.
name: Ice Ball
shortDescription: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.

description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
name: Ice Beam
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze the target.

description: The turn after using this move, the user surrounds the target with an ultracold, freezing wind to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
name: Ice Burn
shortDescription: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. 30% burn.

description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
name: Ice Fang
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze. 10% chance to flinch.

description: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Ice Hammer
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Speed by 1.

description: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
name: Ice Punch
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze the target.

description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Ice Shard
shortDescription: Usually goes first.

description: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.
longDescription: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.
name: Ice Spinner
shortDescription: Ends the effects of terrain.

longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
name: Icicle Spear
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Icy Wind
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.
longDescription: The user prevents all opposing Pokemon from using any moves that the user also knows as long as the user remains active.
name: Imprison
shortDescription: No foe can use any move known by the user.

description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.
longDescription: The target loses its held item if it is a Berry or a Gem. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
name: Incinerate
shortDescription: Destroys the foe(s) Berry/Gem.

description: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
name: Infernal Parade
shortDescription: 30% burn. 2× power if target is already statused.

description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to burn the target.

shortDescription: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

description: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
name: Infestation
shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

description: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.
longDescription: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect. During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.

shortDescription: Traps/grounds user; heals 1/16 max HP per turn.

description: The user instructs the target to reuse the move last used by the target.
longDescription: The target immediately uses its last used move. shortDescription: The target immediately uses its last used move.
