name: Poison Sting
shortDescription: 30% chance to poison the target.

description: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Poison Tail
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to poison.

description: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
longDescription: If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.
name: Pollen Puff
shortDescription: If the target is an ally, heals 50% of its max HP.

description: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.
name: Poltergeist
shortDescription: Fails if the target has no held item.

description: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.
longDescription: Hits ten times. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit ten times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move hits four to ten times at random without checking accuracy between hits.
name: Population Bomb
shortDescription: Hits 10 times. Each hit can miss.

description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Pounce
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.
name: Pound
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and damages the target.
longDescription: If the target uses a Fire-type move this turn, it is prevented from executing and the target loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. This effect does not happen if the Fire-type move is prevented by Primordial Sea.
name: Powder
shortDescription: If using a Fire move, target loses 1/4 max HP.

description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave opposing Pokémon frozen.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
name: Powder Snow
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze the foe(s).

description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
name: Power Gem
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.
longDescription: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.
name: Power Shift
shortDescription: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.

description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
longDescription: The user and the target have their Attack and Special Attack stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Attack and Special Attack stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
name: Power Split
shortDescription: Averages Attack and Sp. Atk stats with target.

description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
longDescription: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.
name: Power Swap
shortDescription: Swaps Attack and Sp. Atk stat stages with target.

description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
longDescription: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.
name: Power Trick
shortDescription: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.

description: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: Power is equal to 20+(X × 20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.
name: Power Trip
shortDescription: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.

description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.
name: Power Whip
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Power-Up Punch
shortDescription: 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Precipice Blades
shortDescription: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

description: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. The gift restores HP sometimes, however.
longDescription: If this move is successful, it deals damage or heals the target. 40% chance for 40 power, 30% chance for 80 power, 10% chance for 120 power, and 20% chance to heal the target by 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
name: Present
shortDescription: 40, 80, 120 power, or heals target 1/4 max HP.

description: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
name: Prismatic Laser
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
longDescription: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
name: Protect
shortDescription: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.
name: Psybeam
shortDescription: 10% chance to confuse the target.

description: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.
longDescription: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5.
name: Psyblade
shortDescription: During Electric Terrain: 1.5× power.

description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
longDescription: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.
name: Psych Up
shortDescription: Copies the target's current stat stages.

description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Psychic
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
longDescription: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
name: Psychic Fangs
shortDescription: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.

description: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
longDescription: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.
name: Psychic Noise
shortDescription: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from healing.

description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.
name: Psychic Terrain
shortDescription: 5 turns. Grounded: +Psychic power, priority-safe.

description: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
name: Psycho Boost
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Psycho Cut
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio.

description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.
longDescription: The user's non-volatile status condition is transferred to the target, and the user is then cured. Fails if the user has no non-volatile status condition or if the target already has one.
name: Psycho Shift
shortDescription: Transfers the user's status ailment to the target.

description: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Psyshield Bash
shortDescription: 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
name: Psyshock
shortDescription: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.

description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
name: Psystrike
shortDescription: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to (user's level) × (X + 50) / 100, where X is a random number from 0 to 100, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Psywave
shortDescription: Random damage equal to 0.5×-1.5× user's level.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
name: Pulverizing Pancake
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Power is equal to 60+(X × 20), where X is the target's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0, but not more than 200 power.
name: Punishment
shortDescription: 60 power +20 for each of the target's stat boosts.

description: The user heals the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.
longDescription: The target is cured if it has a non-volatile status condition. If the target was cured, the user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
name: Purify
shortDescription: Cures target's status; heals user 1/2 max HP if so.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: If an opposing Pokemon switches out this turn, this move hits that Pokemon before it leaves the field, even if it was not the original target. If the user moves after an opponent using Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch, but not Baton Pass, it will hit that opponent before it leaves the field. Power doubles and no accuracy check is done if the user hits an opponent switching out, and the user's turn is over; if an opponent faints from this, the replacement Pokemon does not become active until the end of the turn.
name: Pursuit
shortDescription: If a foe is switching out, hits it at 2× power.

description: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
name: Pyro Ball
shortDescription: 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.

description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
longDescription: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
name: Quash
shortDescription: Forces the target to move last this turn.

description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Quick Attack
shortDescription: Usually goes first.

description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
longDescription: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
name: Quick Guard
shortDescription: Protects allies from priority attacks this turn.

description: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
name: Quiver Dance
shortDescription: Raises the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Once this move is successfully used, the user's Attack is raised by 1 stage every time it is hit by another Pokemon's attack as long as this move is chosen for use.
name: Rage
shortDescription: Raises the user's Attack by 1 if hit during use.

description: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: Power is equal to 50+(X × 50), where X is the total number of times the user has been hit by a damaging attack during the battle, even if the user did not lose HP from the attack. X cannot be greater than 6 and does not reset upon switching out or fainting. Each hit of a multi-hit attack is counted, but confusion damage is not counted.
name: Rage Fist
shortDescription: +50 power for each time user was hit. Max 6 hits.

description: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.
longDescription: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
name: Rage Powder
shortDescription: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.

description: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
longDescription: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated. If the user's current form is a Paldean Tauros, this move's type changes to match. Fighting type for Combat Breed, Fire type for Blaze Breed, and Water type for Aqua Breed.
name: Raging Bull
shortDescription: Destroys screens. Type depends on user's form.

description: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
longDescription: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
name: Raging Fury
shortDescription: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain.
name: Rain Dance
shortDescription: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.

description: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
longDescription: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Rapid Spin
shortDescription: Free user from hazards/bind/Leech Seed; +1 Spe.

description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Razor Leaf
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.

description: The user cuts the target with sharp shells to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Razor Shell
shortDescription: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
name: Razor Wind
shortDescription: Charges, then hits foe(s) turn 2. High crit ratio.

description: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.
longDescription: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
name: Recover
shortDescription: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
longDescription: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.
name: Recycle
shortDescription: Restores the item the user last used.

description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
name: Reflect
shortDescription: For 5 turns, physical damage to allies is halved.

description: The user reflects the target's type to become the same type as the target.
longDescription: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.
name: Reflect Type
shortDescription: User becomes the same type as the target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: The user cures its burn, poison, or paralysis. Fails if the user is not burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.
name: Refresh
shortDescription: User cures its burn, poison, or paralysis.

description: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing Pokémon. This may also induce sleep.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep. If this move is successful on at least one target and the user is a Meloetta, it changes to Pirouette Forme if it is currently in Aria Forme, or changes to Aria Forme if it is currently in Pirouette Forme. This forme change does not happen if the Meloetta has the Sheer Force Ability. The Pirouette Forme reverts to Aria Forme when Meloetta is not active.
name: Relic Song
shortDescription: 10% chance to sleep foe(s). Meloetta transforms.

description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.
longDescription: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.
name: Rest
shortDescription: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.

description: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.
longDescription: Power doubles if one of the user's party members fainted last turn.
name: Retaliate
shortDescription: Power doubles if an ally fainted last turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness × 2/5), rounded down, or 1.
name: Return
shortDescription: Max 102 power at maximum Happiness.

description: The user attacks the target by dancing with all its might. This move becomes the same type as the user's type.
longDescription: This move's type depends on the user's primary type. If the user's primary type is typeless, this move's type is the user's secondary type if it has one, otherwise the added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat. This move is typeless if the user's type is typeless alone.
name: Revelation Dance
shortDescription: Type varies based on the user's primary type.

description: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.
longDescription: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.
name: Revenge
shortDescription: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.

description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
longDescription: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
name: Reversal
shortDescription: More power the less HP the user has left.

description: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.
longDescription: A fainted party member is selected and revived with 1/2 its max HP, rounded down. Fails if there are no fainted party members.
name: Revival Blessing
shortDescription: Revives a fainted Pokemon to 50% HP.

description: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.
longDescription: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain and the target is grounded, this move's power is doubled.
name: Rising Voltage
shortDescription: 2× power if target is grounded in Electric Terrain.

description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
longDescription: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
name: Roar
shortDescription: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

description: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can't move on the next turn.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
name: Roar of Time
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
name: Rock Blast
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.
name: Rock Climb
shortDescription: 20% chance to confuse the target.

description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.
name: Rock Polish
shortDescription: Raises the user's Speed by 2.

description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Rock Slide
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

description: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Rock Smash
shortDescription: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.
name: Rock Throw
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Rock Tomb
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

description: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can't move on the next turn.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
name: Rock Wrecker
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's Ability.
longDescription: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
name: Role Play
shortDescription: User replaces its Ability with the target's.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Rolling Kick
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.
name: Rollout
shortDescription: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.

description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.
longDescription: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user is not Terastallized, until the end of the turn Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.
name: Roost
shortDescription: Heals 50% HP. Flying-type removed 'til turn ends.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all grounded Grass-type Pokemon on the field by 1 stage.
name: Rototiller
shortDescription: Raises Atk/Sp. Atk of grounded Grass types by 1.

shortDescription: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.

description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
longDescription: If the user is Terastallized, this move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes, and this move's type becomes the same as the user's Tera Type. In addition, if the user's Tera Type is Stellar, this move has 100 power, is super effective against Terastallized targets and neutral against other targets, and lowers the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Tera Blast
shortDescription: If Terastallized: Phys. if Atk > SpA, type = Tera.

description: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.
longDescription: If the user is a Terapagos in Stellar Form, this move's type becomes Stellar, hits all opposing Pokemon, and becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes.
name: Tera Starstorm
shortDescription: Terapagos-Stellar: Stellar type, hits both foes.

description: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
longDescription: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.
name: Terrain Pulse
shortDescription: User on terrain: power doubles, type varies.

description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.
longDescription: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
name: Thief
shortDescription: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

description: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.
longDescription: This move can hit airborne Pokemon, which includes Flying-type Pokemon, Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, Pokemon holding an Air Balloon, and Pokemon under the effect of Magnet Rise or Telekinesis. If the target is a Flying type and is not already grounded, this move deals neutral damage regardless of its other type(s). This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.
name: Thousand Arrows
shortDescription: Grounds adjacent foes. First hit neutral on Flying.

description: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can’t flee from battle.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
name: Thousand Waves
shortDescription: Hits adjacent foes. Prevents them from switching.

description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
longDescription: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
name: Thrash
shortDescription: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

description: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
longDescription: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.
name: Throat Chop
shortDescription: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound moves.

description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
name: Thunder
shortDescription: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.

description: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
name: Thunder Cage
shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

description: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
name: Thunder Fang
shortDescription: 10% chance to paralyze. 10% chance to flinch.

description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Thunder Punch
shortDescription: 10% chance to paralyze the target.

description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Thunder Shock
shortDescription: 10% chance to paralyze the target.

description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.
longDescription: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.
name: Thunder Wave
shortDescription: Paralyzes the target.

description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Thunderbolt
shortDescription: 10% chance to paralyze the target.

description: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
longDescription: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.
name: Thunderclap
shortDescription: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.

description: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Thunderous Kick
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

description: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
name: Tickle
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1.

description: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.
name: Tidy Up
shortDescription: User +1 Atk, Spe. Clears all substitutes/hazards.

description: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.
longDescription: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.
name: Topsy-Turvy
shortDescription: Inverts the target's stat stages.

description: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Torch Song
shortDescription: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
longDescription: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
name: Torment
shortDescription: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.

description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
longDescription: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
name: Toxic
shortDescription: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.

description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
longDescription: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.
name: Toxic Spikes
shortDescription: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.

description: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage and poisons it.
name: Toxic Thread
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 and poisons it.

description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Trailblaze
shortDescription: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.

description: The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set.
longDescription: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.
name: Transform
shortDescription: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.

description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
name: Tri Attack
shortDescription: 20% chance to paralyze or burn or freeze target.

description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.
longDescription: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
name: Trick
shortDescription: User switches its held item with the target's.

description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
name: Trick Room
shortDescription: Goes last. For 5 turns, turn order is reversed.

description: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
longDescription: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
name: Trick-or-Treat
shortDescription: Adds Ghost to the target's type(s).

description: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.
longDescription: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Triple Arrows
shortDescription: High crit. Target: 50% -1 Defense, 30% flinch.

description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
longDescription: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
name: Triple Axel
shortDescription: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.

description: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.
longDescription: Hits three times.
name: Triple Dive
shortDescription: Hits 3 times.

description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
longDescription: Hits three times. Power increases to 20 for the second hit and 30 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
name: Triple Kick
shortDescription: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.

description: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Trop Kick
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: The power of this move is based on the amount of PP remaining after normal PP reduction and the Pressure Ability resolve. 200 power for 0 PP, 80 power for 1 PP, 60 power for 2 PP, 50 power for 3 PP, and 40 power for 4 or more PP.
name: Trump Card
shortDescription: More power the fewer PP this move has left.

description: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Twin Beam
shortDescription: Hits 2 times in one turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Hits twice, with each hit having a 20% chance to poison the target. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Twineedle
shortDescription: Hits 2 times. Each hit has 20% chance to poison.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
name: Twinkle Tackle
shortDescription: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.
name: Twister
shortDescription: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
longDescription: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
name: U-turn
shortDescription: User switches out after damaging the target.

description: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn with altered priority greater than 0, or if the target moves before the user.
name: Upper Hand
shortDescription: 100% flinch. Fails unless target using priority attack.

description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
longDescription: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
name: Uproar
shortDescription: Lasts 3 turns. Active Pokemon cannot fall asleep.

description: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. This lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Speed, Defense, and Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: V-create
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.

description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Vacuum Wave
shortDescription: Usually goes first.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness × 2/5), rounded down, or 1.
name: Veevee Volley
shortDescription: Max happiness: 102 power. Can't miss.

description: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 1 stage if the target is poisoned. Fails if the target is not poisoned.
name: Venom Drench
shortDescription: Lowers Atk/Sp. Atk/Speed of poisoned foes by 1.

description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
longDescription: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.
name: Venoshock
shortDescription: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

description: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
name: Victory Dance
shortDescription: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Speed by 1.

description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
name: Vine Whip
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
name: Vise Grip
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.
longDescription: This move does not check accuracy.
name: Vital Throw
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy. Goes last.

description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
longDescription: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
name: Volt Switch
shortDescription: User switches out after damaging the target.

description: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Volt Tackle
shortDescription: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Power doubles if the target is asleep. If the user has not fainted, the target wakes up.
name: Wake-Up Slap
shortDescription: Power doubles if target is asleep, and wakes it.

description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
name: Water Gun
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.
longDescription: If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Water Gem, and cannot be redirected by the Storm Drain Ability.
name: Water Pledge
shortDescription: Use with Grass or Fire Pledge for added effect.

description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.
name: Water Pulse
shortDescription: 20% chance to confuse the target.

description: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.
longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is an Ash-Greninja with the Battle Bond Ability, this move has a power of 20 and always hits three times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
name: Water Shuriken
shortDescription: Usually goes first. Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: For 5 turns, all Fire-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.
name: Water Sport
shortDescription: For 5 turns, Fire-type attacks have 1/3 power.

description: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
longDescription: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
name: Water Spout
shortDescription: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Waterfall
shortDescription: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.
longDescription: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Wave Crash
shortDescription: Has 33% recoil.

description: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.
longDescription: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Strong Winds is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Heavy Rain or Rain, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Intense Sun or Sun. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Heavy Rain, Rain, Intense Sun, or Sun, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.
name: Weather Ball
shortDescription: Power doubles and type varies in each weather.

description: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
name: Whirlpool
shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

description: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
longDescription: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
name: Whirlwind
shortDescription: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

description: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.
longDescription: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
name: Wicked Blow
shortDescription: Always results in a critical hit.

longDescription: Has a 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep.
name: Wicked Torque
shortDescription: 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep.

description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
longDescription: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
name: Wide Guard
shortDescription: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.

description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.
longDescription: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Wild Charge
shortDescription: Has 1/4 recoil.

description: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to paralyze the target. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.
name: Wildbolt Storm
shortDescription: 20% chance to paralyze foe(s). Rain: can't miss.

description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.
longDescription: Burns the target.
name: Will-O-Wisp
shortDescription: Burns the target.

description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
name: Wing Attack
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.
longDescription: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
name: Wish
shortDescription: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.

description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Withdraw
shortDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 1.

description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
name: Wonder Room
shortDescription: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.

description: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.
longDescription: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Wood Hammer
shortDescription: Has 33% recoil.

description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Work Up
shortDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.
longDescription: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
name: Worry Seed
shortDescription: The target's Ability becomes Insomnia.

description: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
name: Wrap
shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Power is equal to 120 × (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
name: Wring Out
shortDescription: More power the more HP the target has left.

description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.
name: X-Scissor
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
longDescription: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.
name: Yawn
shortDescription: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.

description: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Zap Cannon
shortDescription: 100% chance to paralyze the target.

description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Zen Headbutt
shortDescription: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Zing Zap
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's evasion by 1 stage.
name: Zippy Zap
shortDescription: Goes first. Raises user's evasion by 1.
